title: Stock-Flow Record
governance_note: Carbon pathway outputs cannot be interpreted responsibly if stock-flow definitions are unclear.

title: Pathway Record
governance_note: Pathway scenarios should not be presented as guaranteed futures.

title: Sink Record
governance_note: Fixed sink assumptions can hide nonlinear carbon-cycle feedback.

title: Budget Record
governance_note: Carbon budgets are conditional estimates, not exact guarantees.

title: Removal Record
governance_note: Net-zero and overshoot claims require removal governance.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Carbon pathway conclusions should not exceed accounting boundaries, evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and tested scope.
